caption: A heavy bowling ball and a light soccer ball rest side by side on a smooth wooden surface. Suddenly, both begin to roll forward, seemingly propelled by an unseen force. The bowling ball moves with a slow, deliberate momentum, its weight causing it to press into the ground slightly. In contrast, the soccer ball rolls more swiftly and lightly. The two balls continue their journey across the ground, maintaining a parallel path, as if engaged in a silent race
